Vir Das Earns Third Emmy Nomination for 'Fool Volume'

Comedian Vir Das has received his third Emmy nomination for his special 'Fool Volume'. The nomination was announced for the International Emmy Awards 2026. Additionally, the Sony LIV web series 'Real Kashmir Football Club' also earned a nomination.
